title: UI & Visual Designer growth roadmap
summary: A plan to strengthen Design fundamentals, learn core tools, create a portfolio, and start professional work. Each phase mixes learning, practice, and reflection.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Lay the visual and conceptual groundwork for effective UI design.

milestones.title: Typography Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can choose and apply typefaces that enhance readability and hierarchy.

tasks.title: Read typographic anatomy
tasks.description: Study font families, weight, leading, and tracking on MDN’s Typography guide.

tasks.title: Analyze three apps’ type systems
tasks.description: Pick three popular apps, note their font choices, sizes, and hierarchy, and record observations in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Create a typographic scale
tasks.description: Design a 8-step type scale in Figma using modular ratios and document usage rules.

tasks.title: Reflect on legibility
tasks.description: Write a short note on how your scale improves readability across devices.

milestones.title: Colour & layout fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can construct balanced layouts and harmonious colour palettes for UI screens.

tasks.title: Study colour theory basics
tasks.description: Read the colour theory section on the Interaction Design Foundation site.

tasks.title: Build a 5-color palette
tasks.description: Use Adobe Color (free) to create a primary, secondary, accent, neutral, and error palette and export swatches.

tasks.title: Sketch three layout grids
tasks.description: On paper, draft 12-column, 8-column, and responsive fluid grids for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

tasks.title: Apply palette to a mock screen
tasks.description: Design a simple login screen in Figma using your palette and grid, focusing on contrast and spacing.

tasks.title: Get feedback on contrast
tasks.description: Post the mock screen in a design community (e.g., Designer News) and note suggestions.

milestones.title: Design thinking refresh
milestones.outcome: Can run a rapid user-centered design process from research to concept.

tasks.title: Read double-diamond overview
tasks.description: Review the double-diamond model on the Nielsen Norman Group site.

tasks.title: Map a user journey
tasks.description: Choose a common task and sketch a journey map with pain points.

tasks.title: Create 3 problem statements
tasks.description: Write concise problem statements based on The journey map insights.

tasks.title: Reflect on assumptions
tasks.description: List assumptions you made and how you could test them.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Become proficient with industry-standard tools and systematic design methods.

milestones.title: Figma Basics
milestones.outcome: Can prototype, componentize, and collaborate efficiently in Figma.

tasks.title: Complete Figma basics tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the free Figma Getting Started videos on the official site.

tasks.title: Build a component library
tasks.description: Create buttons, inputs, and cards as reusable components with variants.

tasks.title: Prototype a simple flow
tasks.description: Link three screens in Figma to simulate a login-to-dashboard journey.

tasks.title: Share and gather comments
tasks.description: Invite a peer to comment on your prototype and incorporate feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on component usage
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how variants simplify design updates.

milestones.title: Design Systems foundations
milestones.outcome: Can define and maintain a coherent design system for UI projects.

tasks.title: Read design system case study
tasks.description: Study the Atlassian Design System overview on their public site.

tasks.title: Document style tokens
tasks.description: Create a Figma file listing colour, spacing, and typography tokens with usage guidelines.

tasks.title: Create a component variant set
tasks.description: Develop a button component with size, state, and intent variants.

tasks.title: Write contribution guidelines
tasks.description: Draft a short README explaining how teammates add or modify components.

tasks.title: Connect with a system maintainer
tasks.description: Join a free design system community (e.g., Design Systems Slack) and ask a question.

milestones.title: Prototyping & Motion Basics
milestones.outcome: Can add micro-interactions and motion to enhance UI feedback.

tasks.title: Watch motion design primer
tasks.description: View the free Motion Design Basics playlist on YouTube (by DesignCourse).

tasks.title: Create a hover animation
tasks.description: In Figma, add a smart animate transition for a button hover state.

tasks.title: Prototype a loading indicator
tasks.description: Design a simple loading spinner using vector shapes and animate it in Figma prototype mode.

tasks.title: Test motion on device
tasks.description: Export the prototype to the Figma mobile app and note performance.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion purpose
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph on when motion adds value versus when it distracts.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Build a concise portfolio that demonstrates your visual and systematic design abilities.

milestones.title: Design System Mini-project
milestones.outcome: A documented, reusable design system ready for showcase.

tasks.title: Define scope and components
tasks.description: Select 5 core UI elements (button, input, card, nav, toast) for the system.

tasks.title: Design component library
tasks.description: Create high-fidelity versions of the 5 components with variants in Figma.

tasks.title: Write usage guide
tasks.description: Add a one-page PDF explaining token usage, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

tasks.title: Record a walkthrough video
tasks.description: Film a 2-minute screen capture walking through the system and upload to YouTube (unlisted).

tasks.title: Publish on portfolio site
tasks.description: Add the system page to your personal website (use GitHub Pages or a free site builder).

milestones.title: Three polished app screens
milestones.outcome: Three end-to-end UI screens that showcase visual polish and consistency.

tasks.title: Choose an app concept
tasks.description: Select a simple app idea (e.g., habit tracker) and outline its core flows.

tasks.title: Sketch wireframes
tasks.description: Create low-fidelity sketches for onboarding, main view, and settings screens.

tasks.title: Apply design system
tasks.description: Use your mini-design system to style the three screens in Figma.

tasks.title: Add micro-interactions
tasks.description: Add hover and transition animations to key elements using Figma’s prototype features.

tasks.title: Export mockups for portfolio
tasks.description: Generate high-resolution PNGs and a short case-study write-up.

milestones.title: Motion prototype Interaction
milestones.outcome: Create a Motion prototype that shows Interaction Design skills.

tasks.title: Select interaction to animate
tasks.description: Pick a common UI pattern (e.g., accordion expand) to showcase motion.

tasks.title: Design states in Figma
tasks.description: Create collapsed and expanded frames with consistent layout.

tasks.title: Add smart animate transitions
tasks.description: Configure Figma prototype to animate between states with easing and duration.

tasks.title: Test on mobile device
tasks.description: Open the prototype on a phone, observe performance, and note any tweaks.

tasks.title: Document design rationale
tasks.description: Write a brief note on why the chosen motion improves usability.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced skills, prepare for handoff, and launch your job or freelance search.

milestones.title: Handoff to engineers
milestones.outcome: Can deliver design specs that developers can implement without ambiguity.

tasks.title: Read handoff best practices
tasks.description: Study the handoff guide on the Figma Help Center.

tasks.title: Create a dev-ready spec page
tasks.description: For one screen, add measurements, colour codes, and component references using Figma’s Inspect panel.

tasks.title: Export assets in required formats
tasks.description: Export icons as SVG and images as WebP, naming them per developer conventions.

tasks.title: Write a brief design rationale
tasks.description: Summarize interaction decisions in a one-page document for developers.

tasks.title: Share with a developer friend
tasks.description: Get feedback on clarity and completeness, then iterate.

milestones.title: Advanced Motion & prototyping
milestones.outcome: Can create complex, timed animations and interactive prototypes for stakeholder demos.

tasks.title: Explore advanced Figma plugins
tasks.description: Install and test the Figmotion plugin for keyframe animation.

tasks.title: Build a multi-step onboarding flow
tasks.description: Design 4 screens with progressive disclosure and animated transitions.

tasks.title: Add timed auto-play animation
tasks.description: Use Figmotion to create a 3-second intro animation that loops once.

tasks.title: Record a demo video
tasks.description: Capture the prototype interaction with screen recording and add captions.

tasks.title: Reflect on performance trade-offs
tasks.description: Write a note on file size, load time, and when to simplify motion.

milestones.title: Job & client readiness
milestones.outcome: A polished portfolio, résumé, and interview strategy tailored to UI design roles.

tasks.title: Update résumé with design metrics
tasks.description: Add quantifiable outcomes (e.g., improved conversion by 12%) for each project.

tasks.title: Craft portfolio case studies
tasks.description: Write a 300-word narrative for each portfolio project, focusing problem, process, and result.

tasks.title: Practice common interview questions
tasks.description: Do a mock interview with a peer, focusing on design decisions and handoff experience.

tasks.title: Network on LinkedIn and Dribbble
tasks.description: Share a project highlight, comment on 3 posts, and request feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on personal brand
tasks.description: Write a short statement of your design philosophy and how it guides your work.
